name: Valstar
why: Milan, 1911 — the Valstarino unlined suede blouson is the quiet grail of Italian outerwear; a century-old house that makes essentially one perfect thing.
origin: Milan, 1911 — began in raincoats (the name contracts Valextra's-era 'Valstar' branding); the Valstarino, an A-1 blouson in unlined suede, became the signature after the war.
opview: Positions the Valstarino as the jacket you buy once.

notes.craft: Milanese make, a century of one silhouette refined
notes.ital: Milan institution — the tailors' casual jacket

cities: Milan · top specialty & luxury e-tail in US
